qualification_intent: Prove that a canonical AUTHOR_DECISION status can affect a governed content-admission subject only when the queue/receipt subject identity is exact and still current. Status alone is never applicability evidence.

required_deterministic_cases.condition: exact currently active governed subject identity is present
required_deterministic_cases.expected: currentness check accepts the exact subject without minting author authority

required_deterministic_cases.condition: same object id but prior/inactive object version
same object id/version but different object digest
required_deterministic_cases.expected: fail closed as non-current/nonexistent exact identity

required_deterministic_cases.condition: approved/resolved decision for subject A is replayed against subject B
required_deterministic_cases.expected: subject B receives no applicability from subject A status or receipt

required_deterministic_cases.condition: parent active pointer advances after a nonterminal decision request was queued
required_deterministic_cases.expected: revalidation overlays the request STALE with ACTIVE_GOVERNED_SUBJECT_CHANGED_OR_REMOVED

required_deterministic_cases.condition: resolve is attempted after strict stale overlay
subject identity refs are missing, malformed, duplicate, or use a non-64-hex digest
required_deterministic_cases.expected: fail closed with the guard's exact validation error and no queue mutation

required_deterministic_cases.condition: append-only identity is valid under its owning currentness semantics
required_deterministic_cases.expected: guard does not invent governed active-pointer semantics for append-only evidence

required_deterministic_cases.condition: present or reopen uses a request whose frozen exact subject is no longer current
required_deterministic_cases.expected: operation fails before author presentation/reopen state can be used as applicability evidence

required_deterministic_cases.condition: exact-match valid request is revalidated without parent subject change
required_deterministic_cases.expected: idempotent currentness disposition; no false STALE overlay

cross_regressions_required: existing author-decision queue deterministic suite remains green
content-admission bridge rejects status-only or wrong-subject applicability
failed currentness checks produce no content-admission mutation and no publication/export effect

protected_boundaries: no author approval is inferred or fabricated
no private manuscript bytes or DEVELOPMENT_GOLD are required or fabricated
no Prose, Book Evaluator, Document, publication-provider, native-platform, or production authority is absorbed
hosted qualification is not authoritative A-01 qualification
evidence_target: deterministic RF012 qualifier executing all 10 required cases
focused and full hosted PASS on the exact changed subject if executable bytes change
zero mutation/effect evidence for every rejected applicability case
exact subject/fixture/qualifier identities preserved in the qualification summary
central content-admission A-01 status remains separately truthful
